clue.text: This a difficult problem finally erased, where rubber's employed

indicators.note: difficult letters are awkward and contrary, so the words this and a are reworked into a new order
finally erased means the last letter of the word for problem is wiped out

parts.note: a problem in arithmetic is a sum

explanation.surface: A tricky problem is resolved at last, somewhere a rubber is put to use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'difficult' rearranges THIS A into SHIAT; 'finally erased' strips the M from SUM, leaving SU. The rubber is a masseur, not an eraser.
explanation.definitionFit: Shiatsu is a Japanese massage technique, so it is a place where a person who rubs bodies is at work.

clue.text: Protagonist taking drugs

parts.note: heroin is a hard drug
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A lead character is shown using narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: One word, 'drugs', supplies two drugs side by side; 'taking' just joins them to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A heroine is the female principal character of a story, its protagonist.

clue.text: Range popular — range popular?

parts.note: an Aga is a make of range cooker, a fixture of British country kitchens
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Someone repeats a phrase about a cooker in fashion, as if in doubt.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'Range popular' is the wordplay; the phrase written a second time is the definition, since it occurs once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing the phrase a second time means it appears once more, which is the sense of repetition the word carries.

clue.text: See 8
Because investing billions inspiring you and I, certain things gathering dust

indicators.note: investing means wrapping round, so the short form of because encloses the rest

parts.note: cos is informal shorthand for because

indicators.note: inspiring is read as breathing in, so the billions take in the pair inside them

parts.note: B is billion, doubled as BB for the plural
you and I together are we

explanation.surface: An investment of billions inspiring two people turns into something left to collect dust.
explanation.walkthrough: Plural billions doubles the abbreviation, as pp does for pages; 'you and I' must be read as the pronoun pair, not two separate people.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobwebs are spider threads that pile up grime in neglected corners, things gathering dust.

clue.text: Nothing secure about buckle originally, as one may be released?

parts.note: O is the zero shape for nothing

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for secure goes round the letter

parts.note: to nail something is to fasten or secure it

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of buckle

explanation.surface: Fastening a buckle with nothing, so someone might be let go.
explanation.definitionFit: A defendant out on bail is released from custody pending trial, the state the phrase describes.

clue.text: Food from a giant, then 3 for old song, might you say?

indicators.note: might you say signals that the words are spoken and only their sound matters

parts.note: the wartime song We'll Meet Again; with 3 (AGAIN) after it, its first two words remain

explanation.surface: A giant's dinner is followed by a repeat, in the style of a nostalgic tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'then 3 for old song' puts the answer to 3 down, AGAIN, after the answer: said out loud the whole sounds like Vera Lynn's 1939 hit We'll Meet Again.
explanation.definitionFit: Whales are giant sea creatures, and their flesh eaten as meat is the food named.

clue.text: Ronet and Otla?

parts.note: read backwards these nonsense names give tenor and alto, voices turned round, i.e. vocalists set back to front

explanation.walkthrough: The names look like a pop duo; reverse them and they are TENOR and ALTO, so they are singers read from the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Backing singers support a lead vocalist; here the voice names are literally written backwards.

clue.text: Film — creation of graduate in it consuming academic in the end

indicators.note: consuming means swallowing, so the rearranged letters take in the extra one
creation of means something new is made from these letters, so they are rearranged
in the end points to the final letter of academic

explanation.surface: A film is born from a graduate eating up a scholar at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'creation of' rearranges GRADUATE IN IT; 'consuming' tucks in C, the last letter of 'academic' ('in the end').
explanation.definitionFit: Educating Rita is the 1983 film of Willy Russell's play, starring Michael Caine and Julie Walters.

clue.text: Hulking beast squeezed into motor caravan

indicators.note: squeezed into says the run of letters sits crammed inside these two words

explanation.surface: A huge animal is crammed into a camper van.
explanation.definitionFit: The killer whale is a massive marine predator, so a hulking creature.

clue.text: Back horse with one limb, "Sea Slug"

indicators.note: back means the word for horse is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: a dun is a horse of greyish-brown colour
I is the Roman numeral for one
a branch is a limb of a tree

explanation.surface: A punter backs a three-legged horse named Sea Slug.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudibranchs are brightly coloured marine molluscs without shells, commonly called sea slugs.

clue.text: Intended return of innocent child effectively starts

indicators.note: return of means the word for innocent is turned back to front

parts.note: naif means naive or innocent

indicators.note: starts picks the opening letter of each of the next two words

explanation.surface: An innocent child is returned, effectively a fresh start.
explanation.definitionFit: One's intended is the person one is engaged to marry, a betrothed man.

clue.text: Standards appear sad, more sad when reported?

indicators.note: when reported signals that the words are heard, not spelt

parts.note: to cry is to appear sad; tearier means more tearful, sadder

explanation.surface: Someone asks how gloomy one must look to be graded properly.
explanation.walkthrough: CRY TEARIER, said aloud, matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Criteria are the benchmarks by which things are judged, i.e. standards.

clue.text: Manager should be cut short in truth for logorrhoea

indicators.note: in places the shortened word inside the word for truth

parts.note: verity means truth

indicators.note: cut short means the word for manager loses its final letter

parts.note: a boss is a manager

explanation.surface: A manager ought to be curt and truthful rather than babbling.
explanation.definitionFit: Logorrhoea is excessive talkativeness, the same as wordiness.

clue.text: Like the coalition, Labour standing to bury one in the future

indicators.note: to bury means the outer piece swallows the rest
standing in a down clue means the word stands upright, read from bottom to top

parts.note: Lab is the short form of the British Labour Party
I is the Roman numeral for one
later means at some future time

explanation.surface: Labour waits to bury a coalition member some time later.
explanation.walkthrough: The coalition is the 2010 Conservative–Liberal Democrat government in Britain, a two-party arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: A coalition of two parties is a two-sided arrangement, involving both sides.

clue.text: Bound to join women's club

parts.note: W is an abbreviation for women
a bound is a limit or boundary, an edge

explanation.surface: Someone is sure to sign up to a women-only club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' reads as certain, but it is the noun for a limit.
explanation.definitionFit: A wedge is a golf club with a steeply angled face.

clue.text: Hide behind first of shredded wheat

indicators.note: first of takes the opening letter of shredded

parts.note: a pelt is an animal hide

explanation.surface: A breakfast tip: tuck in after the first bite of shredded cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: Spelt is an ancient species of wheat grown for flour.

clue.text: Circling the border, there's me dropping a plant

indicators.note: circling means the altered name goes round the word for border
dropping a means the letter A falls lower, to the bottom of this down entry

parts.note: me is the setter, Paul
a rim is a border or edge

explanation.surface: Someone loses something while pacing round a garden edge looking for a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: Paul often clues himself as 'me'. In this down entry 'dropping a' lets that letter fall to the foot of his name before 'Circling' puts it round the border.
explanation.definitionFit: Primula is a genus of flowering plants including primroses and cowslips.

clue.text: Local boat enters before part of cycle

parts.note: a local is a British pub, an inn

indicators.note: enters means the boat goes inside the word for before

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
a tub is a slow, clumsy boat

explanation.surface: A pub's boat comes in ahead of some stage of a cycle race.
explanation.definitionFit: An inner tube is the inflatable ring inside a bicycle tyre, a component of a bike.

clue.text: Anteater buried nose initially inside one climbing

indicators.note: inside places the hidden pair within the upturned word
climbing in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
hid means buried or concealed

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of nose

explanation.surface: An anteater pokes its nose in while climbing.
explanation.definitionFit: The echidna is the spiny anteater of Australia and New Guinea.

clue.text: Name boy, still abandoned — is he?

definitions.text: Name boy, still abandoned — is he?

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a boy who is still left alone deserves a nickname.
explanation.walkthrough: BILLY NO-MATES is British slang for someone with no friends; the whole clue both builds and describes him.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang name describes a friendless loner, someone left abandoned by all.

clue.text: Chap and friend detailed old language

parts.note: a chap is a man

indicators.note: detailed means the tail, the last letter, is removed

parts.note: a chum is a friend

explanation.surface: A man and his friend are given details of an old tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like 'precise' but means de-tailed, docked of its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchu is the Tungusic language of the Manchu people, which ruled China under the Qing.

clue.text: Description of some missiles having bearing on dispersal of a riot

parts.note: an air is a manner or bearing

indicators.note: dispersal of means the letters of a riot are scattered and regrouped

explanation.surface: Missiles are relevant to breaking up a disturbance.
explanation.definitionFit: Air-to-air missiles are fired from one aircraft at another, a category of weapon.

clue.text: I'm flipping plugging the blessed lecture!

indicators.note: plugging means filling a hole, so the reversed pair sits inside

parts.note: holy means blessed

indicators.note: flipping means the letters are turned over, read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An irritated listener complains about the blessed sermon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British swear word, but it is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A homily is a sermon or moralising lecture.

clue.text: See 21
Well oiled builder's bum, something furry in it

indicators.note: in it means the furry thing goes inside the rearranged letters
bum means bad or faulty, so the letters of builder are botched into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
a cat is a furry creature

explanation.surface: A builder's exposed backside, with something furry stuck in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bum' looks like the famous visible bottom of a British builder; it signals that BUILDER is rearranged to LUBRIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Well oiled can mean greased, which is exactly what being lubricated is.

clue.text: Introductions only typical of your Sheridan plays

indicators.note: introductions are the opening letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A remark that only the openings are characteristic of Sheridan's plays.
explanation.walkthrough: Richard Brinsley Sheridan was an 18th-century Irish playwright.
explanation.definitionFit: To play with something is to toy with it, so toys is the verb meaning plays.

clue.text: Experience suffering in fight for financial rescue package

indicators.note: in places the word for suffering inside the word for fight

parts.note: a bout is a fight
to ail is to experience suffering

explanation.surface: Going through pain in a battle for a financial bailout.
explanation.definitionFit: A bailout is a rescue from financial difficulty, usually by government money.

clue.text: Dork opening gift that's not for suckers!

indicators.note: opening means the fool splits the gift open and sits inside

parts.note: a boon is a gift or blessing
an ass is a fool, a dork

explanation.surface: A fool unwraps a present meant for someone who isn't a sucker.
explanation.walkthrough: Wind instruments are blown, not sucked, so this one is no instrument for suckers.
explanation.definitionFit: A bassoon is a woodwind instrument played by blowing through a reed, never by drawing breath in.
